page_title: WER 3-3 HEI | Werder Bremen v Heidenheim 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Ole Werner appears to have said too much and referee Matthias Jollenbeck comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90+6' Having seen unsporting behavior, Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is the recipient.
90+5' 3 - 3 Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) takes a wonderful free kick and curls the ball into the top left corner with an absolutely phenomenal strike!
90+4' The main referee, Matthias Jollenbeck, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+4' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Matthias Jollenbeck lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+4' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) sees a yellow card from Matthias Jollenbeck after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+1' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Romano Schmid is replaced by Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
85' The linesman raises his flag. Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) is adjudged offside.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch for Marco Grull.
83' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) replaces Luca Kerber.
81' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.

79' 3 - 2 Superb finishing from Marco Grull (Werder Bremen). Jens Stage plays a fantastic through ball and finds Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goal and fire a low shot from close range past the goalkeeper. It's 3:2.
77' That will be all from Frans Kratzig who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
76' It's time for a substitution. Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) comes on in place of Paul Wanner.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
75' Substitution. Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Marvin Ducksch walks off.
75' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Derrick Kohn will be replaced by Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen).
75' A substitution has been made. Senne Lynen is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
73' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
72' Flag goes up against Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
71' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) gets a yellow card.
70' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card!
64' Caution goes to Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim).
64' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Matthias Jollenbeck didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

61' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Luca Kerber (Heidenheim) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the right side of the target. The assist goes to Budu Zivzivadze and the score changes to 2:2.
59' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header!
57' A pass from Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) is intercepted by Kevin Muller and the move breaks down.
56' 2 - 1 Goal! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 2:1.
54' Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
52' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) misses a big chance as his shot goes wide of the left post.
49' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.
47' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
46' Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) surprisingly hits a direct free kick goalwards from long distance, but the effort goes wide of the post.
45' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Werder Bremen.
42' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) latched on to a cross and struck a header just wide of the left post.
40' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker wide of the left post.
38' Werder Bremen fail to score from a corner as Kevin Muller (Heidenheim) leaps to collect the ball.
32' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar.

30' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Michael Zetterer, so the score changes to 1:1.

30' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer pulls off an easy save.
26' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.
25' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

24' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the right side of the goal, but Kevin Muller makes a nice save. The referee blows his whistle, Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
23' The yellow card is received by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
20' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
19' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
18' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
15' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

11' A wonderful opportunity! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the bottom left corner. However, Kevin Muller makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the post.
9' Frank Schmidt is forced to make a change. Niklas Dorsch is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
7' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' 1 - 0 Goal! Romano Schmid plays it to Marco Grull (Werder Bremen), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Kevin Muller. 1:0.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Werder Bremen will take the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
